purpose: Prove canonical-source fidelity independently from platform capability and preserve unresolved requirements as explicit build triggers.

canonicalSource.contentHandling: Input-only; raw canonical content is excluded from reports.

candidateContent.contentHandling: Input-only; raw candidate content is excluded from reports.

requirements.platformHardLimit: Optional boolean; true requires boundaryEvidenceRef and enables exact-scope hard-limit language. Absence of a proven route otherwise remains UNRESOLVED_CAPABILITY.

resultStates.REJECT_DILUTION: Candidate failed the selected fidelity contract; route selection is not performed.
resultStates.PLATFORM_BOUNDARY: Canonical source passed, but one or more exact platform requirements remain unresolved and are emitted as stable AO-CRA build triggers.
resultStates.ROUTE_READY_LOCAL: Every requirement has a native or adapter route with at least deterministic test evidence; no execution is claimed.
resultStates.ROUTE_READY_PROVEN: Every selected route carries provider readback proof; no new execution is performed by this evaluator.
resultStates.INVALID_INPUT: The request failed schema or evidence validation and no result was admitted.

invariants: Fidelity is evaluated before capability negotiation.
A fidelity failure cannot be repaired by an adapter route.
Platform limitations never authorize deletion or weakening of canonical source.
Absence of capability evidence is never promoted to a proven platform hard limit.
Adapters require deterministic test evidence, rollback evidence, and a fidelity evidence reference.
Authority, recurring cost, user burden, and external effects are bounded by policy.
Provider execution state is always NOT_EXECUTED for this evaluator.
Runtime, deployment, and completion claims require their own provider receipts.

composition.boundary: The generic kernel classifies platform gaps; provider-specific mutation remains outside this package.

rollback: Discard the candidate or generated report; the canonical source is immutable and this evaluator performs no provider mutation.
